text: Attempt 5 begins. Fire first: no tree parks in any plan, rubble cleared, every run stops on new rubble, airport in the empty north-east corner far from homes. Build order as attempt 4.

Attempt 5 started. Four tries so far: three were burned down by great fires, all four ran out of money. This time the plan is to survive fires first: no tree parks, quick firebreaks, and an airport far from homes.
Feb 2001: loan #2, district a20-2003 built; the 2002 plan (coal plant + north riverbank pumps) ran out of cash part-way - finish it with loan #3.
Jul 2002: power ran out (116 buildings dark); loan #3 finished the coal plant and 19 north riverbank pumps.
Jul 2002: loan #4, second coal plant + north district (shops on top, homes, factories).
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 8 (demand -942), shops 7 -> 8 (demand 611), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: factories 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Jul 2003: zoo (home demand was negative) + finance ordinances and City Beautification.
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1870)
Jul 2004: loan #5; airport in the empty north-east corner (x116-121 y0-3), 17 rows from the nearest homes, with a power line through it and its own fire station.
12,250 people in mid-2004, on pace. The airport went into the far north-east corner this time, well away from homes, so a plane crash can't torch a district.
Oct 2006: stadium beside the zoo (home demand -1,482).
Oct 2006: loans #6-7; district 5 (no tree parks), seaport + east job strip, 14 south riverbank pumps.
Feb 2007: weak trip land is mostly the new airport and north shops; jobs are the gap (unemployment 12%), running on to let the seaport strip fill.
Tax controller: factories 10 -> 9 (demand -819)
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 8 (demand -647)
Feb 2011: 17,180 people and all demand negative with only one road link: loan #8 for road links to the east and south map edges and a second seaport.
Growth stalled at about 17,000 in 2008-2011: shops and factories had nowhere to trade. Added two road links to neighbouring cities and a second seaport.
Jul 2011: loan #9; coal plant on its own in the east with a fire station (power was 9% spare), 4 more fire stations.
Tax controller: homes 8 -> 7 (demand -803), shops 8 -> 6 (demand -993), factories 8 -> 6 (demand -184)
Jul 2012: 20,390 people, unemployment 11-20% since 2008 and all demand negative; taxes cut to homes 7 / shops 6 / factories 6 to bring jobs.
CONTROL: I ran 2007-2010 with the trips and pace alarms overridden for 12 steps and the city sat stalled at ~15,000 for three years without action. Overrides from now on are for 1-2 steps only.
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 6 (demand -686)
Dec 2013: loan #10 taken over the guard (projected -$97k by 2050): the city earns too little at 23,000 people; only growth fixes that, and factories have demand 1,077 with no land.
Dec 2013: south district x76-100 y98-109: factories in the middle cells with homes on both sides, no parks.
Tax controller: factories 6 -> 7 (demand 1242)
Tax controller: factories 7 -> 8 (demand 1584)
Tax controller: factories 8 -> 9 (demand 1911)
Feb 2015: loan #11 (over the guard); dense factory + home block x54-75 y56-68 beside the seaport.
25,000 people in 2015, behind attempt 4's pace but growing again: a tax cut fixed 20% unemployment and all demand is positive. Money is the worry: 11 loans already.
Jul 2015: south-east district x101-125 y97-110 (shops, homes; zoo site kept free until cash allows), pipe joined to the x107 main.
Tax controller: shops 6 -> 7 (demand 1761), factories 9 -> 10 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1974)
